tasks.name: runtime-phase-b-gc-syscall
tasks.scopedGoal: Ship the v0.3 runtime Phase B GC scaffolding and syscall parking polish per platform-spec. Today `compiler/crates/beskid_runtime/CONCURRENCY_STATUS.md` records Phase A is landed (M0-M8), but Phase B (multiple mutators, real `gc_write_barrier` on channel edges, optional preemption at function entry) is documented as Known Gap. Deliver: (a) abfall + beskid_runtime support for multiple Beskid mutator threads with the documented `gc_write_barrier` actually doing work (no longer a no-op on pointer stores in codegen-emitted code); (b) function-entry preemption hooks (optional flag, off by default but compiled in); (c) cross-fiber pointer-payload channel send with copy/GC tracing on receive (per spec); (d) tighten syscall parking so the syscall pool can never re-enter as a second mutator without `enter_runtime_scope`. Spec anchors: site/website/src/content/docs/platform-spec/execution/runtime/fiber-scheduler-and-stacks/**, site/website/src/content/docs/platform-spec/execution/runtime/memory-and-gc-runtime-contract/**, site/website/src/content/docs/platform-spec/execution/runtime/panic-io-and-syscalls/**, site/website/src/content/docs/platform-spec/execution/runtime/channels-and-synchronization/**.
